content:
maria: Quick follow-up from last night's incident postmortem — we need runbook edits + action owners. Summarized action items below. @jin can you own triage scripts? @alex-m take on escalation matrix edits?

jin: I can take triage scripts. Plan: add a scripted checklist + healthcheck commands. I'll PR by Tue EOD. Need a canonical command set for quickly collecting KV cache + model pool status.

alex-m: I'll update escalation paths: add 15m page, 30m exec notify, fallback model policy. Will link to PagerDuty config. PR by Fri.

sam-devex: Can we add short reusable commands in the playbook? e.g., `./scripts/collect_incident.sh` — will add wrapper and small examples for mobile/web devs.

maria: Putting owners/times in thread. Also we should add explicit 'when to page' thresholds. Current proposal: 5% sustained latency increase for >5m OR error rate >1% for >3m. Agree?

jin: Agree on thresholds. Adding example troubleshooting commands to include in runbook:
```bash
# check runtime health
curl -sS http://localhost:9090/health | jq .
# dump model pool keys
redis-cli -h redis-main SMEMBERS model_pools
# get last 200 runtime logs
journalctl -u redwood-runtime -n 200 --no-pager
```
Will include these and a short note on what fields to look for (queue_depth, kv_hit_rate, gpu_util).

alex-m: Also adding escalation snippet for fallback switches:
```text
1) Switch routing policy to low-latency fallback: PUT /admin/routing {"variant":"fallback"}
2) Force cache warm: POST /admin/cache/refresh
3) Restart a misbehaving worker: systemctl restart redwood-worker@<id>
4) Notify status page and customers if >15m impact
```

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-4823: "runbook - triage scripts and escalation paths". Assigned to jin. Due 2026-03-31.

maria: Great. Final owner list:
- jin: triage scripts + checklists (PR by Tue EOD, issue RW-INC-4823)
- alex-m: escalation matrix + paging thresholds (PR by Fri)
- sam-devex: helper scripts + examples (add to docs package)

We'll sync Wed 10:00am to review PRs in #incidents. @channel please add anything missing or blockers.

jin: Noted. I'll start the PR today and tag reviewers: @alex-m, @sam-devex, @maria.

alex-m: :thumbsup:
